content:
The test `test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache` failed because an `<hp:linesegarray>` element was found within a modified paragraph. In HWPX files, these elements act as a layout cache; if the text is changed but the cache remains, the viewer may display overlapping or incorrect text. 

To fix this, when modifying a paragraph (`<hp:p>`), you must find and remove the `<hp:linesegarray>` child element. 

Trace highlight:
`E AssertionError: assert <Element '{http://www.hancom.co.kr/hwpml/2010/HWPML}linesegarray' ...> is None`
reasoning: The trace clearly identifies the specific XML element causing the failure. Providing this exact element name allows the Planner to target the fix precisely in the XML manipulation logic.
